title: KEYS ARE KEYCAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): the menus and text still look bad, make it look like a triple-A game. UI redesign build ui7, keycaps. A prompt in the world printed its key as text in brackets ([E] SEARCH) with the brackets coloured amber. The key is now drawn as a keycap, an amber key with a dark letter, and on a controller the button in its own colour (A green, B red, X blue, Y yellow), the way the big games show a key. The keys in the title key row and the stash key bar are keycaps too. His own wording of a prompt still applies to the whole line, and the word editor still picks the whole line.
now: Prompts in the world and the key rows on the title and in the stash show each key as a keycap instead of a letter in brackets.
